# When readings in context glue, for parity / 奇偶约束下语境中的读法何时粘合

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`gluing-under-parity` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](gluing-under-parity.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where each context requires a parity, a context-free reading exists exactly where no selection of contexts contradicts (each claim counted evenly, the parities adding to odd); then mixtures of context-free readings meet at most m − 1 of the m contexts on average, readings in context all m.
>
> 每个语境要求奇偶时，有不依语境的读法，恰当没有语境的选择矛盾（每个主张被计偶数次而所要求的奇偶相加为奇）；有矛盾时，不依语境之读法的混合平均至多满足 m 个语境中的 m − 1 个，按语境索引的读法满足全部 m 个。

## Laws / 规律

1. Arithmetic of parity: parities added (addParity) and the parity of a quantity over a list (oddOver); association, exchange and self-cancelling, parity carried through maps and termwise addition, and the bounds on counting.<br>奇偶上的算术：两个奇偶相加（addParity）与一个量在列表上的奇偶（oddOver）；结合、交换、自消，奇偶在映射与逐项相加下的传递，及计数之界。 (`Becoming.addParity`, `Becoming.oddOver`, `Becoming.addParity_false`, `Becoming.addParity_self`, `Becoming.addParity_assoc`, `Becoming.addParity_swap`, `Becoming.addParity_and`, `Becoming.addParity_solve`, `Becoming.addParity_cancel`, `Becoming.true_of_ne_false`, `Becoming.cond_le_one`, `Becoming.and_congr_of`, `Becoming.oddOver_add`, `Becoming.oddOver_and`, `Becoming.oddOver_congr`, `Becoming.oddOver_false`, `Becoming.oddOver_swap`, `Becoming.oddOver_map`, `Becoming.image_of_mem_map`, `Becoming.count_le_length`, `Becoming.count_all`, `Becoming.met_step`, `Becoming.even_le_of_odd`)
2. A parity constraint gives the claims it counts and the parity it requires; constraints added are a constraint; a list of constraints contradicts where, added, it counts no listed claim and requires odd; where they contradict, every assignment fails an odd number of them.<br>奇偶约束给所计的主张与所要求的奇偶；约束相加仍是约束；一组约束矛盾，指它们相加后不计任何所列主张而要求奇；矛盾时每个赋值不满足其中奇数个。 (`Becoming.ParityConstraint`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.value`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.add`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.value_add`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.Contradicts`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.value_even`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.unmet_odd`)
3. Elimination: with equality of claims decided and the claims listed without repetition, the listed claims are eliminated one at a time, as in solving linear equations over two values; for every list of constraints either an assignment meets each or a selection of them contradicts, a contradiction found after an elimination carried back to the constraints it came from.<br>消去：主张的相等可判定、列举不重复时，逐一消去所列主张，如在两个值上解线性方程；对每组约束，或有赋值满足每一个，或其中一组矛盾，消去后找到的矛盾带回它所来自的约束。 (`Becoming.ParityConstraint.eliminate`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.counts_after`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.eliminate_counts`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.met_after`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.pulled`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.pull_back`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.met_or_contradicts`)
4. A parity system gives each context the claims it counts and the parity it requires (ParitySystem); an assignment lies within a context's possibilities where its parity on the counted claims is the required one, which depends only on the claims the context registers; a contradiction is a selection of contexts, repetition allowed, counting every claim an even number of times while the required parities add up to odd.<br>奇偶系统列出主张，给每个语境它所计的主张与所要求的奇偶（ParitySystem）；赋值在语境的可能之内，恰当其所计主张之值的奇偶是所要求的；语境能显示的只取决于它所识的主张；矛盾是语境的一个选择（可重复），每个主张被计偶数次而所要求的奇偶相加为奇。 (`Becoming.ParitySystem`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.constraint`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.within`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.value`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.support`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.met`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.Contradicts`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.local_`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.contradicts_iff`)
5. The obstruction: every context-free assignment fails an odd number of a contradiction's contexts, one found by checking each, so no context-free reading lies within every context's possibilities; it meets at most m − 1 of the m contexts, and so does a mixture (assignments counted with repetition) on average; where each context can be met alone, readings indexed by context meet all m.<br>障碍：每个不依语境的赋值不满足矛盾中奇数个语境，逐个核对即找到一个，所以没有不依语境的读法在每个语境的可能之内；它至多满足矛盾的 m 个语境中的 m − 1 个，其混合（可重复计入的赋值列表）平均亦然；每个语境单独可满足时，按语境索引的读法满足全部 m 个。 (`Becoming.ParitySystem.unmet_odd`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.unmet_of_contradicts`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.contradicts_noGlobal`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.met_le`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.mixture_le`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.indexed_met`)
6. The only obstruction: with equality of claims decided and the claims listed without repetition, for every list of contexts a context-free assignment meets each or a selection contradicts; so, the contexts listed, no context-free reading exists exactly where a selection contradicts, and a world registering what each context counts, respecting the possibilities and gluing, exists exactly where none does.<br>唯一的障碍：主张的相等可判定、列举不重复时，对每个语境列表，或有不依语境的赋值满足其中每个语境，或其中某个选择矛盾；所以语境被列出时，没有不依语境的读法恰当有选择矛盾，有登记每个语境所计者、尊重其可能、在其配置粘合的世界恰当没有。 (`Becoming.ParitySystem.lift_selection`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.global_or_contradicts`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.noGlobal_iff`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.glues_iff`)
7. Specker's three boxes: each opening counts its two boxes and requires odd; the three openings contradict, every mixture meets at most two of the three on average, and each opening read by its own placement meets all three; Becoming.Context's Specker.noGlobal follows from the contradiction.<br>Specker 的三个盒子：每次打开计其两个盒子并要求奇；三次打开矛盾，每个混合平均至多满足三中之二，每次打开以自己的放置满足全部三个；Becoming.Context 的 Specker.noGlobal 由矛盾推出。 (`Becoming.Specker.paritySystem`, `Becoming.Specker.two_iff`, `Becoming.Specker.two_iff_swap`, `Becoming.Specker.support_iff`, `Becoming.Specker.openings`, `Becoming.Specker.openings_contradict`, `Becoming.Specker.noGlobal_of_contradiction`, `Becoming.Specker.mixture_le`, `Becoming.Specker.indexed_met`)
8. The CHSH game (Clauser, Horne, Shimony and Holt, 1969): two stations with two settings each, whose outcomes must differ exactly where both settings are the second; the four pairs of settings contradict, every mixture of context-free outcomes wins at most three of the four on average (the classical bound), and outcomes read in their pair win all four.<br>CHSH 博弈（Clauser、Horne、Shimony、Holt，1969）：两个站各有两个设置，结果恰在两个设置都是第二个时须不同；四对设置矛盾，不依语境之结果的每个混合平均至多赢四中之三（经典之界），在语境中读出的结果赢全部四个。 (`Becoming.CHSH.Outcome`, `Becoming.CHSH.outcomes`, `Becoming.CHSH.same`, `Becoming.CHSH.paritySystem`, `Becoming.CHSH.two_iff`, `Becoming.CHSH.support_iff`, `Becoming.CHSH.pairs`, `Becoming.CHSH.pairs_contradict`, `Becoming.CHSH.mixture_le`, `Becoming.CHSH.inPair`, `Becoming.CHSH.inPair_support`, `Becoming.CHSH.indexed_met`)
9. The Mermin–Peres square: each line counts its three cells, and only the third column requires odd; the six lines contradict, every mixture meets at most five of the six on average, and values read in their line meet all six; Becoming.Context's Square.noGlobal follows from the contradiction.<br>Mermin–Peres 方阵：每条线计其三个格，只有第三列要求奇；六条线矛盾，每个混合平均至多满足六中之五，在线中读出的值满足全部六条；Becoming.Context 的 Square.noGlobal 由矛盾推出。 (`Becoming.Square.cells`, `Becoming.Square.counts`, `Becoming.Square.paritySystem`, `Becoming.Square.lines`, `Becoming.Square.three_iff`, `Becoming.Square.not_beyond`, `Becoming.Square.support_iff`, `Becoming.Square.cells_even`, `Becoming.Square.lines_contradict`, `Becoming.Square.noGlobal_of_contradiction`, `Becoming.Square.mixture_le`, `Becoming.Square.inLine`, `Becoming.Square.inLine_support`, `Becoming.Square.indexed_met`)
10. A cycle: the claims 0, …, n in a cycle, neighbours related as equal or different (Cycle.system), each claim counted twice along its relations; so with an odd number of differ relations they contradict and mixtures meet at most n of the n + 1 on average; with an even number the assignment walked along the cycle meets them all, and the two exclude each other (Cycle.met_iff_even).<br>环：主张 0, …, n 成环，相邻者以相等或相异相关（Cycle.system），每个主张沿其关系被计两次；所以相异关系为奇数个时这些关系矛盾，混合平均至多满足 n + 1 个中的 n 个；为偶数个时沿环走出的赋值满足全部关系，二者互斥（Cycle.met_iff_even）。 (`Becoming.Cycle.down`, `Becoming.Cycle.system`, `Becoming.Cycle.edges`, `Becoming.Cycle.polarity`, `Becoming.Cycle.length_edges`, `Becoming.Cycle.lt_of_mem_down`, `Becoming.Cycle.shift`, `Becoming.Cycle.cross`, `Becoming.Cycle.returns`, `Becoming.Cycle.eq_of_even`, `Becoming.Cycle.beq_self`, `Becoming.Cycle.beq_of_ne`, `Becoming.Cycle.telescope`, `Becoming.Cycle.counts_even`, `Becoming.Cycle.contradicts`, `Becoming.Cycle.mixture_le`, `Becoming.Cycle.miss`, `Becoming.Cycle.pick`, `Becoming.Cycle.value_pair`, `Becoming.Cycle.walk`, `Becoming.Cycle.walk_meets`, `Becoming.Cycle.met_iff_even`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No axiom. The claims and contexts are listed; the obstruction and the m − 1 bound need nothing more; uniqueness (elimination) takes equality of claims decided and the claims listed without repetition; a mixture is a list of assignments counted with repetition, its weights natural numbers.<br>不加公理。主张与语境被列出；障碍与 m − 1 之界不用其他条件；唯一性（消去）以主张的相等可判定、主张列举不重复为条件；混合是可重复计入的赋值列表，以自然数计权重。

## Does not show / 未表明

- The quantum values: Tsirelson's bound needs real amplitudes and is not stated here (Becoming.Quantum realizes the square with integer matrices).<br>量子值：Tsirelson 之界需要实数振幅，这里不陈述（Becoming.Quantum 以整数矩阵实现方阵）。
- Contextuality beyond parity constraints (general possibilities, probabilistic contextuality) is given no exact law.<br>超出奇偶约束的语境性（一般的可能性、概率的语境性）没有给出确切规律。
- Which registrations of an actual unfolding are of this parity kind: that is correspondence.<br>实际展开的哪些识是这种奇偶的：这是对应。
- Readings indexed by context meet all m only where each context can be met alone; without a contradiction nothing more follows about them.<br>没有矛盾不推出每个语境都单独可满足之外的东西：按语境索引的读法满足全部 m 个，需要每个语境单独可满足。 Witness: `Becoming.ParitySystem.indexed_met`.
- **Counterexample / 反例:** Specker's boxes, CHSH and the Mermin–Peres square: each contradicts, so no context-free reading exists, while readings indexed by context meet every context; a cycle with an odd number of differ relations contradicts likewise.<br>Specker 的盒子、CHSH 与 Mermin–Peres 方阵：每个都矛盾，所以没有不依语境的读法，而按语境索引的读法满足每个语境；有奇数个相异关系的环同样矛盾。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Gluing.lean)

### Correspondence / 对应

Ren asked on 12 October 2026 whether what a frame loses is like “wave/particle”, and agreed with the reply reading a value as a registration in context; on 15 October 2026: “please make best of your judgement, and push the frontier of completeness”. This result is the next step of contextual-registration, “the general parity obstruction; probabilistic contextuality”: for parity constraints, “context-free claims are a commitment of the representation” becomes an exact law, the commitment failing exactly at a checkable obstruction, which gives a Bell-type bound. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026, DELEGATED-CHOICES D33): the difference between m − 1 and m is what the context carries; a value is a registration in context, a relation.<br>Ren 2026-10-12 问框架所失去的是否像“wave/particle”，并同意了把值读作语境中的识的回答；2026-10-15：“please make best of your judgement, and push the frontier of completeness”。本结果是 contextual-registration 的下一步“奇偶障碍的一般定理；概率的语境性”：对奇偶约束，“不依语境的主张是表示的承诺”成为确切的规律，这一承诺恰在一个可检查的障碍处失效，障碍给出 Bell 型的界。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 2026-10-15 的交托采用，DELEGATED-CHOICES D33）：m − 1 与 m 之差，是语境所承载的；值是语境中的识，一个关系。
